sections.title: No verb needed
sections.content: To the seller's questions you can answer with only the thing, as the English "Two kilos of apples." does. Because the thing is what the question asks for, it keeps its object ending: *Mit kérsz? – Almát.* To add more, start with *még*: *Még három banánt.* To stop, say *Ennyi.* The total is a price with no verb: *Összesen ezerháromszáz forint.*

items.english: What would you like? – A kilo of apples.
What would you like? – The red apples.

sections.content: Keep the *-t* when you answer with the object alone: *Almát.*, not *Alma.* After a number the thing stays singular: *Három banánt.*, not *Három banánokat.*
